04/08/2002: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
            - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
              from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=405. 
 
 
10/29/2001: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
            - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
              from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=605. 
 
 
04/04/2001: Data Correction (Jim Brown) 
 
            - Since the Pyranometer was not properly installed until 
              04/03/2001 (day=93), all solar radiation values prior 
              to and including 04/03/2001 (day=93) from the raw data  
              sets were marked to missing and the MAWN database  
              entries for CERESCO were rebuilt to reflect this 
              change. 
 
              The entries marked to missing were the following: 
              note: field values assume to start at 00. 
 
                 Daily Reports (24): 
 
                    Field 12: Total Solar Radiation 
                    Field 13: Maximum Solar Density 
                    Field 14: Time of Maximum Solar Density 
 
                 Hourly Reports (60): 
 
                    Field 06: Solar Radiation 
 
                 Five Minute Reports (05): 
 
                    n/a 
 
 
04/03/2001: Field Maintanence (Jeff Andresen & Fred Nurnberger): 
 
            - Pryanometer:  Cap removed and instrument mounted 
                            properly on pyranometer stand. 
 
            - Leaf Wetness: Leaf Wetness grid added to default 
                            mounting rod (facing north, approx. 
                            one meter high, on NE leg) 
 
 
11/01/2000: Battle Creek (Ceresco) station added to MAWN database 
 
 
10/30/2000: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
            - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
              from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1815. 
              Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
              Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
              consideration when using this data. 
 
 
10/20/2000: Data Logging Activated (mawn1b) 
            
               Data Logger Start Time:  00:05, Day=294 (10/20/2000) 
 
 
10/19/2000: Phone Line To Station Activated. 
 
 
10/19/2000: Station Installed.   
 
            - Leaf Wetness A:  N/A 
 
                               Conduit mounted on NE leg, 40" from center  
                               of tripod..  Missing bracket. 
                               Bracket will need to be mounted 39.73" high  
                               (1-meter), facing north. 
 
            - Soil Temp A:     2-inch under sod, west of south leg, north 
                               of Soil Temp B (straight in from fence post). 
 
            - Soil Temp B:     4-inch under sod, west of south leg, south of 
                               Soil Temp A (straight in from fence post). 
 
            - Soil Moisture A: East of south leg, approx. one foot north 
                               of Soil Moisture B (straight in from post). 
 
            - Soil Moisture B: East of South leg, approx. one foot south 
                               of Soil Moisture A (straight in from post). 
 
            - Air Temp/RH:     HMP45C (requires mawn1b).  59" to 8th ring 
                               of radiation shield 
 
            - Wind Vane:       Points to North 
 
            - Anemometer:      Points to South 
 
            - Pyranometer:     Stand mounted to SW.  Bottom of bracket 
                               is 39" above tripod bracket. 
 
            - Solar Panel:     Installed near the top of the mast, bracket 
                               sits six inches below coupling at the top 
                               of the mast.  The top edge of the solar panel 
                               must not exceed height of the Pryanomter.   
                               Solar panel faces south with an angle of  
                               about 45-degrees. 
 
            - Precipitation:   Tipping bucket rain guage.  Mounted on NW leg 
                               fence post.  39.73" (1 meter) to top of rain 
                               guage. 
 
            - Phone Line:      Com200 modem.  Mounted to back of enclosure. 
                               RJ11 wire strung from phone box to modem. 
                               Ground wire from modem to earth ground. 
  
                                  n/a       => tip 
                                  n/a       => ring 
                                  n/a       => ground 
 
            - Needs:           Leaf Wetness Mounting Block, Pyranometer Mount 
 
 
            - Comments:        Switched P1 and P2.  Pre-install had the two 
                               leads connected into the wrong port.  Changed 
                               to the following: 
  
                                  P1 ... Anemometer 
                                  P2 ... Rain Guage
